entities.name: Spoken-Word Knowledge Systems
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Systems of preserving and transmitting knowledge through the spoken word, song, ritual performance, and mnemonic devices rather than writing. Before and alongside literacy, every human society relied on remembered and performed knowledge — epic recitation, proverb chains, ceremonial chanting, and apprenticeship instruction — to maintain cultural continuity across generations.
